hero.subtitle: Vyrvona — Your all-in-one AI study companion
hero.lead: Vyrvona is an all-in-one smart companion for learning and study management — from collecting and streaming course materials to interactive notes, AI flashcards, and spaced repetition, so ideas stick deeply and last.

mock.readerBodyBefore: When information is reviewed just before it would be forgotten, the brain rebuilds the memory; that retrieval effort strengthens neural pathways and creates
mock.readerBodyAfter: . Active learners test themselves instead of passively re-reading.
mock.note1: Key tip: first review within 24 hours.
mock.miniA: Review at expanding intervals, just before forgetting

features.title: Everything a serious learner needs
features.lead: Deep-study tools in one smart space — no jumping between a dozen apps.
features.f1Body: Keep all your textbooks in one place, stream them, and study in a calm focused environment.
features.f2Body: Highlight text; AI turns it into standard flashcards instantly.
features.f3Body: Smart review timing, right before forgetting — for deep, lasting memory.
features.f4Body: Focused study sprints with clear goals — to beat procrastination and build habits.
features.f5Body: Timely, personalized nudges — so your study streak never breaks.
features.f6Body: Annotate inside the reader; organize notes and turn them into review cards.

how.title: Learning in four simple steps
how.lead: From source to long-term memory — one continuous flow.
how.s1Body: Import your textbooks into your digital library.
how.s2Body: Study with focus and mark the key ideas.
how.s3Body: AI builds standard flashcards from your highlights.
how.s4Body: Use spaced repetition to lock concepts into long-term memory.

srs.title: Try the science of lasting memory now
srs.lead: Click the card to flip it; then rate the review and see how Vyrvona schedules the next one.
srs.q: In spaced repetition, when is each concept reviewed?
srs.a: At expanding intervals — just before you'd forget it.
srs.sideBody: The brain follows the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve: without review, most learning fades in days. Vyrvona schedules expanding reviews at the right moment — so each idea sticks with minimal repetition.
